definition_reproduction.cluster_note: False-alert clusters are temporal groups of overlapping hourly forecast opportunities, not independent storm samples.
definition_reproduction.issue_time_cluster_rule: Sort predicted >=0.50-ft 24h target windows by issue time; one cluster continues while adjacent issue times differ by <=24 h. A cluster is false only when none of its own linked target windows has an observed >=0.50-ft rise.

false_vs_true_alert_cluster_comparison.interpretation: Descriptive comparison across alert episodes; these clusters are serially dependent and covariate co-occurrence is not causation.

group_independence_audit.interpretation: The 109 groups are temporally declumped target episodes, not proven independent physical hydrologic events. Overlap with the separate Phase 3B >=1-ft response catalog is descriptive only; non-overlap does not establish physical independence.

summary.phase6_definition: 24-hour native-stage target rise >=0.50 ft; qualifying target times separated by <=24 hours are grouped. Forecast alerts must be issued before the group's first qualifying valid target and occur on a qualifying target row.
